# Manuscript Formatting Tool

> Free browser-based manuscript formatting tool that prepares Microsoft Word .docx files for print and Adobe InDesign — maps paragraph and character styles, cleans up returns/quotes/tabs, and exports clean .docx or InDesign Tagged Text. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Upload a .docx, format your manuscript, fix styles, and export a clean file or InDesign Tagged Text.
- [Free Manuscript Formatter](/free-manuscript-formatter): Landing page for authors and novelists — what the free manuscript formatter does, how it works, and FAQs.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free to Try (no exports) vs $5 Day Pass (24h unlimited) vs $29 Lifetime Unlock (one-time, forever). No subscription.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about pricing, exports, .docx and InDesign Tagged Text, local processing, refunds, and who the tool is for.
